title: RulEstimate
description: Experimental remaining-useful-life proxy with uncertainty. Producer: M5 (RUL & Validation). Consumer: M6.

cycles.description: Point estimate of remaining operating cycles/hours.

lowerBound.description: Lower bound of the confidence range.

upperBound.description: Upper bound of the confidence range.

trend.description: Direction of RUL over the recent window. Must never show IMPROVING during active degradation injection — validated by M5 acceptance tests.

experimental.description: Always true. This estimate is a demonstrator proxy, not field-validated remaining life.

basis.description: Which method produced this estimate, for judge transparency.
